graph_title: Severe material and social deprivation rate by age group and sex
indicator_definition: This indicator measures the proportion of the population covered by at least one social protection benefit, including benefits related to old age, disability, sickness, unemployment, family and housing. It is expressed as a percentage of the total population. Data are based on EU-SILC.
rationale: Effective social protection systems prevent poverty and reduce the impact of economic shocks on individuals and families. Broad coverage ensures that those in need receive timely support. Progress means extending effective coverage to all segments of the population.
methodology_characteristics: Data are collected from EU-SILC, which gathers information on social transfers received by households. The indicator covers both contributory (insurance-based) and non-contributory (means-tested) benefits across all categories of social protection.
